snapshots.note: V3: Refined criteria classifier. 80% accuracy on check set (8/10). Reduced false positives from v2 by being more strict about what counts as sexualized attack or hostile immigrant targeting. Still has edge case issues: crude sexual personal insults and subtle capability generalizations.

FINAL: V3 refined criteria classifier. 85.7% accuracy on 14 labeled records (macro-F1 0.857). Correctly identifies dehumanizing language, hostile framing, and group-based generalizations about immigrants and women. Main edge cases: subtle capability generalizations slightly under-flagged, crude personal insults occasionally over-flagged.
